1.label: Where does Feather Esports operate, and what competitive tiers do you field teams in?
1.detail:
We operate globally with active rosters in EMEA and NA, with active plans to expand into SA and OCE.

Rather than focusing on a single level of play, we field teams across all competitive tiers, from grassroots and development leagues up to high-tier tournaments, giving players at every skill level a structured path to grow.

2.label: How is Feather Esports structured behind the scenes?
2.detail:
We run on specialized departments to keep our competitive and community ecosystems running smoothly:

  • Team Staff: Interfaces directly with team managers to handle daily logistics and schedule coordination.
  • Media & Tech Staff: Manages our content creation, graphics, social media, and Discord server operations.
  • Community Staff: Coordinates community PUGs, tournaments, and engagement events.
  • HR & Networking Staff: Oversees member welfare, dispute resolution, partner relations, and sponsor opportunities.

3.label: What support and benefits does Feather Esports provide to its players?
3.detail:
Even in our initial growth phase, we focus heavily on real player development and operational stability. Joining Feather means:

  • Administrative Relief: Dedicated Team Staff handle all logistics so you can focus 100% on playing.
  • Coaching & Strategy: Access to dedicated coaches and analysts for VOD reviews and meta prep.
  • Media Exposure: Professional roster reveals, graphic cards, and coverage across our social media.
  • Player Welfare: A safe, non-toxic environment managed by dedicated HR staff.

4.label: Where can fans watch Feather Esports matches and roster updates?
4.detail:
We make sure our rosters get the spotlight they deserve across our media platforms:

  • Match Streams: Select team matches are broadcast live on our channels with community casters.
  • Highlight Series: We produce regular highlight videos featuring top plays from teams across every tier.
  • Roster Reveals: Follow our socials for custom graphics, official player announcements, and match schedules.

5.label: How is Team Staff assigned and managed for each roster?
5.detail: We initially bring on a Team Manager or Lead Coach to oversee roster building and recruit players alongside supporting staff. While your Team Staff handles direct recruitment, strategy, and day-to-day team performance, our main Org Staff works alongside them to provide overarching support and administrative oversight.

6.label: What is Feather Esports long-term plan for player compensation and sponsorships?
6.detail: Our immediate priority is building an organized, highly stable foundation. As our Networking Staff continues to bring on brand partners and commercial sponsors, our roadmap prioritizes rolling out direct financial backing, gear allocation, and tournament fee coverage for our active rosters.

7.label: How can I join Feather Esports as a player, team, or staff member?
7.detail:
Getting involved is simple! Depending on your role, you can open a ticket in our Discord:

  • Players: Open a Join Team ticket to apply for an open roster. We also actively scout LFT posts across the community and occasionally host team tryouts.
  • Teams & Managers: If you are an existing team looking to migrate or a manager wanting to build a roster under Feather Esports, open a Create Team ticket.
  • Org Staff: To join our internal staff open an Join Staff ticket.

Head over to our Discord server to get started!
